description: Estimate the qualified tips deduction from reported tips after the $25,000 cap and the income phaseout. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

cap.description: Annual tips deduction cap (US dollars). Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 25000 USD from Schedule 1-A (Form 1040) 2025, Part II; 26 U.S.C. 224(b), effective 2025-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

employeeTips.description: Cash and charged tips reported to your employer (US dollars). Tips on Form W-2 (box 7 / box 12 code TP) for the year, including shared tips.

filing.description: Filing status for the deduction. Pick the option that matches your situation for the tax year. Options: single = Single, head of household or qualifying surviving spouse; joint = Married filing jointly; mfs = Married filing separately (deduction not allowed).

form4137.description: Unreported tips you report on Form 4137 (US dollars). Tips not reported to the employer that you include on Form 4137.

magi.description: Modified adjusted gross income (MAGI) (US dollars). AGI plus any excluded foreign or territory income.

occupation.description: Occupation confirmation. Pick the option that matches your situation for the tax year. Options: yes = I confirmed the work is in an occupation on the Treasury list that customarily and regularly received tips on or before Dec 31, 2024; no = Not confirmed, or not a listed tipped occupation.

per1000.description: Reduction for each whole $1,000 over the threshold (US dollars). Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 100 USD from Schedule 1-A (Form 1040) 2025, Part II; 26 U.S.C. 224(b), effective 2025-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when filing is single or joint; ignored otherwise.

seNet.description: Net income from that business before this deduction (US dollars). Gross income including the tips minus that business’s other deductions. Self-employed tips count only up to this amount.

seTips.description: Tips received in your own business (not as an employee) (US dollars). Tips reported on Form 1099 or Schedule C.

serviceCharges.description: Mandatory service charges or negotiated amounts included above (US dollars). Automatic gratuities and other amounts that are not voluntary. They are subtracted because they do not qualify.

thrJoint.description: MAGI phaseout threshold, joint return (US dollars). Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 300000 USD from Schedule 1-A (Form 1040) 2025, Part II; 26 U.S.C. 224(b), effective 2025-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when filing is joint; ignored otherwise.

thrSingle.description: MAGI phaseout threshold (US dollars). Official figure, prefilled from the source named below. Change it only if a newer or different figure applies to you. Official reference value 150000 USD from Schedule 1-A (Form 1040) 2025, Part II; 26 U.S.C. 224(b), effective 2025-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when filing is single; ignored otherwise.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.
